root_cause.text: The `update_eth_regs_async` function in the pegasus USB ethernet driver fails to free the allocated URB (`async_urb`) and control request buffer (`req`) when the asynchronous URB submission via `usb_submit_urb` fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in the error handling path of `update_eth_regs_async()`, calls to `usb_free_urb(async_urb)` and `kfree(req)` were added to release these resources when the submission fails.
